postgres.scope: Actual non-superuser app/Admin LOGINs with fixed three-table projection from actual runtimeBusinessPrivilegePlan, runtimeAdminBoundary and local Hono/real middleware/controller. Table UPDATE on Admin is real; no false column-ACL denial claimed.

nativeTypeAnnotationProof.changes: Two erased TypeScript Array assertions on actual fixture SQL result values; SQL, assertions and production code unchanged.

businessImport.reason: Sandbox EPERM renaming initial Temp Vitest import. Root final local memory execution used owned TEMP/TMP; raw failure retained, not counted.

unitTypes.reason: Native fixture exec exposes memory/native result union: three property errors then two explicit-cast overlap errors. Final two unknown/Array type assertions erase completely; identical esbuild JS proof retained. No production SQL or assertion changed.

limitations: Referenced role permission/status changes and delete currently return409, including superadmin. This is an explicit temporary behavior restriction, not completion of the assigned-role change workflow.
Affected-admin preview, operation-bound revision, explicit confirmation, atomic durable operation receipt, and unknown-outcome recovery remain open.
Legacy dedicated PUT setting/role/set_status/:id/:status and DELETE setting/role/:id remain absent. Legacy staff/account forms and writes remain separate open contracts.

Table barriers serialize all mutations on public.system_admin/system_role; contention is409 without automatic retry. Real production scale and Hyperdrive behavior are not verified by these local fixtures.
The actual Admin table UPDATE profile permits raw platform SQL writes. Application LOGIN is restricted by the actual runtime boundary; handler checks are not a database prohibition on Admin raw SQL.
Local Hono mounts execute real middleware/controllers, not full production app, rendered old/new browsers, provider, device or production account/data acceptance.
Native raw stdout includes harmless PostgreSQL25P01 ROLLBACK-after-COMMIT cleanup warnings, retained without filtering.
Old approved d5c31e8 public publication/CI and older Cloudflare releases are separate historical payloads; this local batch has no new public push, merge or deployment credit.
